title: Rect from four numbers
prompt: Return a Rect2 whose top-left corner is at (x, y) and which is width wide and height tall. This is what draw_rect takes.
signature: func solve(x, y, width, height) -> Rect2:
starter:
func solve(x, y, width, height) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2()

tests.name: A unit square at the origin

hints: Rect2 can be built from four numbers in the same order as the parameters.

docs.name: Rect2(x, y, width, height)
docs.what: Makes a rectangle from a top-left corner and a size. Also Rect2(position, size) with two vectors.

solution:
func solve(x, y, width, height) -> Rect2:
	return Rect2(x, y, width, height)
